remarks: Experience the perfect blend of townhouse convenience and single-family privacy in this beautifully updated home at Orchard Hills. Boasting an open-concept main floor, the residence features a gourmet kitchen complete with granite countertops, rich hardwood floors, and premium stainless steel appliances. The inviting living room, anchored by a classic marble fireplace, flows seamlessly into the dining area-creating an ideal space for hosting family and friends.    Upstairs, you will find two spacious en-suite bedrooms, including a luxurious Primary Suite featuring a brand-new, spa-like bath and custom closet. The bright, walk-out lower level is a versatile haven, offering a family room with custom built-ins, ample space for a quiet home office, and a dedicated laundry room with abundant storage. Swing open the French doors to your private bluestone terrace, perfect for al fresco dining overlooking the manicured grounds.   With the complex recently undergoing extensive renovations-including all-new siding, roofs, drainage, and landscaping-this home offers total peace of mind. Enjoy lazy afternoons by the community pool, or take a short, scenic stroll to Mead Park and the world-class dining and shopping in the Village of New Canaan.
